_about: Nini right (near) front flipper grip point per frame, in the 0 0 300 300 viewBox (feet anchor 150,292). angle = suggested brush direction in degrees, canvas convention (0 = pointing right, -90 = up), from the grip towards the bristle tip. The handle may stick out ~16 px behind the grip; bristle tip ~60 px ahead at in-SVG scale.
